hypothesis: The exact MU 15m breakout-pressure route may add a repeatable source-native edge after finite-depth fills, fees, funding, latency, stop behavior, and one-position-per-route lifecycle accounting.
decision: Continue prospective report-only collection with the frozen route and no v52 live change. Fixed-horizon long markouts remain positive after removing the largest winner, but the strategy-lifecycle replay is technically incomplete and winner-dependent: only 3 of 11 attempted episodes resolved, stress net excluding the largest winner is negative, and no short lifecycle resolved. Reassess only after a predeclared larger resolved sample or new evidence that directly repairs the identified path-coverage limitation.
falsifier: Reject the candidate if the next predeclared resolved lifecycle window is non-positive after stress costs or largest-winner removal, if short-side resolved evidence remains absent, or if source-native mark and depth coverage cannot resolve a materially larger share of prospective lifecycles without synthetic prices.

proposal_contract.recommendation: Keep MU report-only and preserve the frozen route while collecting exact prospective mark, depth, funding, and exit evidence.
proposal_contract.why_now: The sample reached twelve eligible onsets and produced three completed lifecycle episodes, enough to reveal that attractive fixed-horizon markouts do not yet translate into robust strategy-exit economics.
proposal_contract.evidence_reviewed: An immutable 408-decision prospective snapshot, 64,575 causal depth rows, 423,772 exact websocket mark rows, official funding, measured fee evidence, stress friction, fixed-horizon markouts, and the source-native lifecycle replay.
proposal_contract.observed_problem_or_opportunity: MU has useful long-side signal cadence and positive fixed-horizon ex-largest markouts, but 8 of 11 attempted lifecycle episodes are censored and the three completed exits rely on one winner.
proposal_contract.applicable_market_regime: Evidence is concentrated in 15m upward breakouts with EMA9 above EMA21 and positive depth-10 pressure. Only one short onset exists and it is unresolved.
proposal_contract.alternatives_considered: Immediate live addition, long-only promotion, parameter retuning, relaxed mark-gap standards, synthetic gap fills, waiting without analysis, and continued exact prospective capture. The first five are unsupported or would weaken causal evidence.
proposal_contract.expected_upside: A materially more complete prospective lifecycle sample can determine whether MU adds repeatable opportunity and portfolio diversification without risking v52 capital prematurely.
proposal_contract.main_risks_and_failure_modes: Winner concentration, one-sided selection, mark-path censoring, portfolio-state censor cascades, entry-depth gaps, source transport mismatch, fees and funding converting small gross wins to net losses, and replay exits differing from historical fills.
proposal_contract.validation_completed: Exact onset identity reconciled 12 of 12; all fixed-horizon entry paths resolved; lifecycle replay included fees, funding, latency stress, stop logic, signal exits, and one-position accounting; no live authority was granted.
proposal_contract.validation_still_required: A predeclared larger sample with materially higher lifecycle resolution, resolved both-side evidence, source parity, depth-sized execution sensitivity, untouched forward confirmation, and stress results that remain positive without the largest winner.
proposal_contract.success_metrics: At least 20 independent prospective onsets, at least 12 resolved lifecycle episodes with both sides represented, positive stress net and stress net excluding the largest winner, no synthetic risk path, and no unresolved source identity.
proposal_contract.failure_or_rollback_triggers: Negative stress or ex-largest lifecycle economics, persistent short-side absence, unresolved-path incidence that remains dominant, fee/funding drag exceeding the gross edge, or any source identity mismatch.

limitations: Eight of eleven attempted lifecycle episodes are technically censored and cannot support economic claims.
All three completed lifecycles are long; the first short lifecycle is mark-path unresolved.
The stress result becomes negative after removing the largest winner.
Funding and costs converted one gross-positive completed lifecycle into a net loss.
Fixed-horizon markouts are diagnostics, not strategy-exit fills or PnL.
Mark-triggered next-observed-depth exits are replay approximations rather than historical venue fills.
The stated sample sizes are investigation thresholds, not live-performance gates or profitability guarantees.
No v52 strategy, asset, route, parameter, leverage, sizing, exit, execution, or deployment setting changed.
